_notes: Optimizer config for the Footprint Reversal AutoTrader SCAFFOLD. SIM ONLY.
This sweeps the signal + exit knobs. Regenerate indices with CS6 first.
increment > 0 -> SWEPT.  increment == 0 -> IGNORED (set MANUALLY in the study).
MANUAL SETUP (the optimizer does NOT set these):
- Trade >> Trade Simulation Mode = ON  (so it can never reach a live broker)
- Stop Buffer Ticks (idx 13)      = 2  (held fixed this pass)
- Input NumberBars2 (idx 3)       = the Number Bars Calculated study ID
- Relative Volume SG14 (idx 4)    = SG14 of that study
(the signal cannot compute without the NumberBars2 dependency wired up)
FOOTPRINT BACKTEST CAVEAT (important): this study needs volume-at-price data
to exist during the replay (it early-returns if VAP < ArraySize). That requires
intraday TICK data loaded and a tick-by-tick replay. Verify the first run
actually produces footprint data + trades before trusting the grid. If you get
zero trades, this is the usual cause.
